title: Seam State Encoding Round Trip
statement: For every streaming seam state $s$, decoding its encoded word recovers $s$ exactly: its fresh-variable cursor, consumed input length, and grammar phase are all recovered.
hypotheses_covered: $s$ is a streaming seam state, whose phase lies in the five-element phase set
